About Me:

Hiyya! My name's Zia, born under the star sigh "Scorpio" so, I'm known to be passionate with anything I put my effort into.

My hobbies include anything Beauty related.
I am a practicing HMUA (Hair and Makeup Artist) in my spare time. I love making people see their beauty and their confidence bloom through my work.

I'm also a big fan of reading and writing.
Aside from beauty related hobbies, I'm also quite good with Traditional Art, specifically sketcking and painting. When I need to decompress from schoolwork, I always gravitate towards a pencil or paintbrush.

And I also am fond of Reading!.
Genres I love reading the most is Poetry and Fiction novels. I love getting lost in a good book.
